intro.title: Steel garages
intro.subtitle: Single and double-car sheet metal garages
intro.p1: Looking for a reliable shelter for your car? Our garages made of galvanized sheet metal are the perfect solution for you! Their solid structure ensures durability and resistance to damage, and a wide range of available colors allows you to match the garage to your individual aesthetic preferences.
intro.p2: Sheet metal garages from GMS System allow you to store your car in safe conditions. They are not only durable but also aesthetically made, and their structure allows for quick assembly. Choose the model that suits you and place your order today!
intro.p3: Our garages are offered in versions for one or two cars, and the entrance doors enable convenient and safe parking of vehicles. Additionally, many garage models have windows that provide an additional source of natural light inside the building.
intro.p4: With our garages, you don't have to worry about weather conditions or the safety of your vehicle - take care of it in the best possible way!

aluminumFloor.title: Aluminum floor
aluminumFloor.subtitle: stability and protection against ground moisture.
aluminumFloor.description: It is possible to equip the garage with a durable anti-slip aluminum floor. This solution prevents moisture penetration and makes it easier to keep the inside of the garage clean.

lifestyle.p1: Our steel garages are not just a safe space for your car or motorcycle. Thanks to a well-thought-out and spacious design, the garage is ideal as a backyard workshop, storage for garden tools, lawnmowers, as well as a safe place to store bicycles or sports equipment for the entire household.
lifestyle.p2: High-quality materials and precise assembly of elements guarantee optimal protection against theft and difficult weather conditions such as strong wind, snow, or rain.
lifestyle.p3: Thanks to the modular design, you can flexibly arrange the interior of the garage with shelves, brackets, and hooks, adapting the space exactly to your individual needs.

showcase1.description: We used a precisely designed locking system that guarantees full rigidity and stability of the garage door in every position. This is a modern and safe solution ensuring many years of trouble-free operation.

showcase2.description: The profiled threshold made of lightweight aluminum ensures a smooth and trouble-free entry of the vehicle or bringing in heavier equipment without the risk of damaging wheels or suspension.
